mapper.sql: oa.id, oa.name, oa.code, oa.region, oa.city_id, c.name AS city_name, oa.channel, oa.type, oa.status, oa.cover, oa.landing_url, oa.rule_json, oa.start_at, oa.end_at, COALESCE(stats.item_count, 0) AS item_count
oa.status = 2 AND (oa.start_at IS NULL OR oa.start_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (oa.end_at IS NULL OR oa.end_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

oai.id, oai.activity_id, oai.target_type, oai.target_id, COALESCE(s.name, d.title, p.title, r.name, t.name, '') AS target_name, oai.title, oai.subtitle, oai.image, oai.sort, oai.extra_json, oai.status
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM operation_activity oa LEFT JOIN city c ON c.id = oa.city_id AND c.region = oa.region LEFT JOIN ( SELECT activity_id, COUNT(1) AS item_count FROM operation_activity_item WHERE status = 1 GROUP BY activity_id ) stats ON stats.activity_id = oa.id WHERE oa.id = #{id} AND oa.region = #{region} AND LIMIT 1

SELECT
FROM operation_activity_item oai INNER JOIN operation_activity oa ON oa.id = oai.activity_id LEFT JOIN shop s ON oai.target_type = 1 AND s.id = oai.target_id AND s.region = oa.region LEFT JOIN deal d ON oai.target_type = 2 AND d.id = oai.target_id AND d.region = oa.region LEFT JOIN post p ON oai.target_type = 3 AND p.id = oai.target_id AND p.region = oa.region LEFT JOIN rank r ON oai.target_type = 4 AND r.id = oai.target_id AND r.region = oa.region LEFT JOIN topic t ON oai.target_type = 5 AND t.id = oai.target_id AND t.region = oa.region WHERE oai.activity_id = #{activityId} AND oa.region = #{region} AND oai.status = 1 ORDER BY oai.sort ASC, oai.id ASC
